statement: The Wii U Pro reference device's exact Bluetooth product-ID combination, SDP information, physical version variants and pairing/reconnect behavior have not been established by the inspected kernel and SDL implementations; source-side match policy must not be treated as a measured retail identity.

applicability.revision: Wii U Pro; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: Needs private owner-authorized device observation; no addresses or identifying data may enter this public corpus.
